detailed_description: The CSS Variables Generator helps you build small sets of design tokens in the browser. You can edit variable names, values, and simple type labels, add or remove rows, choose a prefix, choose a scope such as :root or theme classes, load light, dark, or brand presets, and copy generated CSS, SCSS, or JavaScript output. Color rows include a color picker and text value field, while other rows use a plain text value field. The tool does not parse variable dependency graphs, validate CSS syntax, convert color spaces, calculate accessibility contrast, support nested fallback relationships, or export JSON files.
usage_steps: Optionally choose a prefix and CSS scope.
Load a light, dark, or brand preset, or add variable rows manually.
Edit each variable name, type label, and value.
Review the generated CSS, SCSS, and JavaScript output panels.
Copy the output format you want to reuse.
usage_examples: Create a small :root token block for colors and spacing.
Load the dark preset and copy CSS variables for a quick theme draft.
Generate SCSS variables from the same names and values used in the CSS output.
Copy a JavaScript object for a simple prototype that needs matching token values.
